messages.content: i need to return a cup to my neighbor and buy bread. help me keep the plan short.
return the cup, then buy bread.
i want to buy bread first because the shop closes in the afternoon.
buy bread first, then return the cup to your neighbor.
do not add a visit or tea. i only need to return the cup.
buy bread, then return the cup. you do not have to stay for a visit.
now give me just the plan, not the reason.
buy bread, return the cup.
what is the first thing?
buy bread.
can you help with this sentence: my brother is going home?
yes. what would you like help with?
i want it to be about my sister instead.
my sister is going home.
now ask it as a question.
is my sister going home?
do you know if she is really going home?
no. we were changing a sentence. you have not said what she is really doing.
just the question one more time.
is my sister going home?
my plan was to wash my clothes and clean the kitchen today. i washed the clothes.
you finished washing the clothes. the kitchen is the other part of your plan.
i now want to read too.
you can add reading to what you want to do after the clothes are done.
did that make the clothes not done?
no. when you add reading, that does not change the work you already finished.
i will leave the kitchen for tomorrow.
then you have finished the clothes, plan to read, and left the kitchen for tomorrow.
what did i really finish today?
washing your clothes.
i need to say i cannot visit my cousin tomorrow. i do not want to give a reason.
sorry, i cannot visit tomorrow.
please do not say i am working. i have not said that.
sorry, i cannot visit tomorrow.
add that i hope to see her another day.
sorry, i cannot visit tomorrow. i hope to see you another day.
did you say why i cannot go?
no. the note does not give a reason.
is that okay as a short note?
yes. it says you cannot visit and that you hope to see her another day.
i have one book with ten words. how many books do i have?
one book.
i take one word out. do i have nine books?
no. you still have one book. you changed the number of words in it.
how many words are still in it?
nine words.
i put the word back.
now the book has ten words again.
how many books now?
still one book.
my friend left a box by the door. what is inside it?
i do not know. you have not said what is inside.
she said it has a toy for my son.
from what she said, there is a toy for your son inside the box.
does that tell you the color of the toy?
no. she did not say its color.
it is blue. i just opened the box.
now you have said the toy is blue.
who is the toy for?
your son.
write a short story where a child takes the wrong bag.
a child took a bag from the chair. it was not the bag she came with. she put it back and found her own bag under the table.
can the child ask someone before taking it?
a child saw a bag on a chair. she asked if it was her bag. a teacher said her bag was under the table, and the child found it there.
now she did not take the wrong bag. is that okay?
yes. asking first helped her find the right bag before taking the wrong one.
just write the last sentence.
the child found her bag under the table.
where was the other bag?
on the chair.
write a kind question asking my neighbor to return my bowl.
could you please return my bowl?
now say cup instead of bowl.
could you please return my cup?
add tomorrow, but keep it kind.
could you please return my cup tomorrow?
did changing the thing mean you had to make it an order?
no. it is still a kind question.
just the question again.
could you please return my cup tomorrow?
i put my books away and washed one cup. i think i will stop now.
you can stop for now. you already did both things.
there is another cup, but i am tired.
you can leave that cup for later if you want to rest now.
do not tell me i washed all the cups.
you washed one cup. another cup is still there.
what other thing did i do?
you put your books away.
thanks. i just want you to understand.
you are welcome.
i have a big bag with a little paper in it and a small bag with books. which should i carry?
the size alone does not tell us. which bag feels light enough for you to carry?
the big bag is light. the small one is hard to hold.
from what you said, the big bag is easy for you to carry and the small one is hard to hold. you could carry the big bag.
so small does not always mean easy to carry?
right. you need to think about what is inside and how easy the bag is for you to hold.
just say the bag i said was light.
the big bag.
what did the small one have inside?
books.
hello pico. can i call you that?
yes. pico is a short name for picoboi.
i want you to call me may.
okay, may.
which name did i ask you to use for me?
may.
and what is your name?
picoboi. you can also call me pico.
answer with just my name.
may.
i wrote yesterday that i felt sad. do you know how i feel now?
no. feeling sad yesterday does not tell me how you feel now.
i feel happy today because i saw my friend.
you feel happy today after seeing your friend.
can both be true?
yes. you can feel sad one day and happy another day.
do not keep saying i am sad now.
okay. you said you feel happy today.
what made today nice?
you saw your friend.
i will meet my brother at the park. what time are we meeting?
you have not said the time.
but you know where.
yes. you said the park.
we said after lunch. does that give a part of the day?
yes. you plan to meet after lunch, but you have not said a clock time.
i just need a note saying after lunch, not a clock time.
we will meet at the park after lunch.
does that note say the place too?
yes. it says the park.
fix this: my sister have a blue bag.
my sister has a blue bag.
why has?
with my sister, we say has in this sentence.
now change my sister to they.
they have a blue bag.
i mean my brother and me instead of they.
my brother and i have a blue bag.
do you know if we really have one?
no. i am helping change the sentence, not saying what you really have.
i will go to the shop for milk and then to the park to meet my friend. why am i going to the shop?
to get milk.
do not tell me all of the plan. why the park?
to meet your friend.
which place is first?
the shop.
now just what i need to buy there.
milk.
did i ask for bread too?
no. you only said milk.
write one short sentence saying i am happy my friend is here. no question.
i am happy my friend is here.
add that we can read together.
i am happy my friend is here so we can read together.
keep it one sentence.
i am happy my friend is here so we can read together.
does it ask my friend to do a thing?
no. it says you are happy and can read together.
just the sentence.
i am happy my friend is here so we can read together.
my mother is a teacher. she is with my father. are there three people because she is a teacher too?
no. your mother is one person who is also a teacher. with your father, that is two people.
i join them. how many now?
three people.
who is the teacher?
your mother.
did i become a teacher when i came to sit with them?
no. coming to sit with them does not make you a teacher.
just the number of people again.
three.
i want to give my friend a drink. i have tea and milk.
what would your friend like?
i think tea, but i do not know for sure.
you could ask if your friend would like tea.
i remember now. she said she does not drink tea.
then leave tea out. you could ask if she would like milk.
what was i not sure about at first?
at first, you were not sure if she would like tea.
what did she really say?
she said she does not drink tea.
my friend is not here, but we said we would meet. did she forget?
i do not know. there could be another reason she is not here.
i want to ask if she is still coming, not say she did not remember.
are you still coming?
can you put hello at the start?
hello. are you still coming? i hope you are okay.
do not say she has to come.
hello. are you still coming? i hope you are okay.
do we know why she is not here?
no. you have not said why.
just tell me the number after four.
five.
that answers my question. thanks.
you are welcome.
no more help for now.
okay.
